Disks.kind.url.note: Machines page, Disks: what a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name ("from a URL, 2.0 GiB"); also in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk read from a web server.

Disks.kind.file.note: Machines page, Disks: what a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name; also in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk image the page reads where it is on the user's computer.

Disks.kind.stored.note: Machines page, Disks: what a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name; also in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk image copied into the browser's storage.

Disks.kind.blank.note: Machines page, Disks: what a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name; also in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. An empty disk made by the page, kept in the browser as the guest writes it.

Disks.kind.ramdisk.note: Machines page, Disks: what a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name; also in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk held in memory, empty at every boot.

Disks.newOverlay.text.message: Name of the new, empty overlay (the disk as the image has it):
Disks.newOverlay.text.note: Machines page, Disks: the question of the text prompt that New empty opens, above the field for the new overlay's name.

Disks.newOverlay.name.note: Machines page, Disks: the name the New empty prompt suggests for the new, empty overlay (the user can change it before Make it).

Disks.newOverlay.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the title of the text prompt that New empty opens (naming a new, empty overlay of the disk).

Disks.newOverlay.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the New empty prompt: makes the overlay and switches the disk to it.

Disks.busy.newOverlay.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a new, empty overlay is made and the disk switched to it.

Disks.busy.switch.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while the disk switches to the overlay chosen in its Changes in list.

Disks.rename.text.note: Machines page, Disks: the question of the text prompt that an overlay's Rename opens, above the field holding its current name.

Disks.rename.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the title of the prompt that an overlay's Rename opens. {{name}} is the overlay's current name.

Disks.rename.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the rename prompt of an overlay.

Disks.busy.rename.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while an overlay is renamed.

Disks.delete.confirm.message: Delete the overlay {{name}}? What the machines wrote to the disk in it ({{size}}) is deleted for good.
Disks.delete.confirm.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirmation (OK/Cancel, the OK in red) that an overlay's Delete asks. {{name}} is the overlay's name, {{size}} what it holds (e.g. "12.0 MiB").

Disks.delete.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the question before an overlay is deleted.

Disks.busy.delete.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while an overlay is deleted.

Disks.merge.other.note: Machines page, Disks: one overlay in the list of those a merge deletes (Disks.merge.others). {{name}} is the overlay's name, {{size}} what it holds.

Disks.merge.others.message: These overlays of the disk are deleted (they were made over its old bytes): {{list}}.
Disks.merge.others.note: Machines page, Disks: the line of the merge's confirmation (Disks.merge.confirm) when the disk has other overlays: a merge deletes them. Starts on a new line. {{list}} is the overlays (each Disks.merge.other), joined with commas.

Disks.merge.snapshots_one.message: {{count}} snapshot pinning them can no longer restore onto the disk without their own copy of it.
Disks.merge.snapshots_one.note: Machines page, Disks: the line of the merge's confirmation (Disks.merge.confirm) when one snapshot pins the disk or the overlays involved. Starts on a new line. {{count}} is 1.

Disks.merge.snapshots_other.message: {{count}} snapshots pinning them can no longer restore onto the disk without their own copy of it.
Disks.merge.snapshots_other.note: Machines page, Disks: the line of the merge's confirmation (Disks.merge.confirm) when several snapshots pin the disk or the overlays involved. Starts on a new line. {{count}} is how many.

Disks.merge.confirm.message: Merge {{overlay}} into {{disk}}? Its changes become the disk's own.{{others}}{{snapshots}}
Disks.merge.confirm.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirmation that Merge into the disk asks (OK in red when it deletes other overlays). {{overlay}} is the overlay's name, {{disk}} the stored disk's; {{others}} is Disks.merge.others or nothing, {{snapshots}} Disks.merge.snapshots or nothing.

Disks.merge.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the question before an overlay is merged into its stored disk.

Disks.busy.merge.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while an overlay's changes are written into its stored disk.

Disks.busy.change.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk's read-only, swap or write in place box is saved.

Disks.detach.keptRamdisk.message: The ramdisk stays in this browser (empty).
Disks.detach.keptRamdisk.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a ramdisk.

Disks.detach.kept.message: The disk stays in this browser, taking its space there.
Disks.detach.kept.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a disk without overlays.

Disks.detach.keptOverlays_one.message: The disk stays in this browser with its {{count}} overlay ({{size}}), taking its space there.
Disks.detach.keptOverlays_one.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a disk with one overlay. {{count}} is 1, {{size}} what the overlay holds.

Disks.detach.keptOverlays_other.message: The disk stays in this browser with its {{count}} overlays ({{size}}), taking its space there.
Disks.detach.keptOverlays_other.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a disk with several overlays. {{count}} is how many, {{size}} what they hold together.

Disks.detach.theDisk.note: Machines page, Disks: names the disk in the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) when its record is missing.

Disks.detach.confirm.message: Detach {{disk}} from {{machine}}? {{kept}} Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser attaches it again (here or to another machine), and deletes it when no machine has it.
Disks.detach.confirm.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirmation that a disk's Detach asks. {{disk}} is the disk's name (or Disks.detach.theDisk), {{machine}} the machine's, {{kept}} one of Disks.detach.kept, Disks.detach.keptOverlays, Disks.detach.keptRamdisk.

Disks.detach.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the title of the confirmation that a disk's Detach asks.

Disks.detach.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the question before a disk is taken off the machine.

Disks.busy.detach.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk is taken off the machine.

Disks.export.title.message: Save the disk to a file: the changes over the image, or the whole disk
Disks.export.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of a disk's Export menu button.

Disks.export.note: Machines page, Disks: the label of a disk's menu button that saves it to a file (its choices: changes only, whole disk as qcow2 or raw).

Disks.export.changes.title.message: A small qcow2 holding what the machine wrote, with the image as its backing file (keep it beside it)
Disks.export.changes.title.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the tooltip of Changes only (qcow2).

Disks.export.changes.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the item that saves what the machine wrote over the disk's image, as a qcow2 backed by the image (not for a blank disk).

Disks.export.qcow2.title.message: The whole disk as a qcow2 (empty space left out)
Disks.export.qcow2.title.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the tooltip of Whole disk (qcow2).

Disks.export.qcow2.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the item that saves the whole disk, with its changes, as a qcow2.

Disks.export.raw.title.message: The whole disk as a raw image
Disks.export.raw.title.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the tooltip of Whole disk (raw).

Disks.export.raw.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the item that saves the whole disk, with its changes, as a raw image.

Disks.export.compress.title.message: Compressed clusters (deflate), as qemu-img convert -c writes them: the file is about half the size and takes longer to write
Disks.export.compress.title.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the tooltip of the Compress the qcow2 checkbox.

Disks.export.compress.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the checkbox (remembered) that compresses a qcow2 export's clusters.

Disks.export.hint.message: A machine running from the disk stops while the file is written, and starts again after.
Disks.export.hint.note: Machines page, Disks › Export menu: the small note at the menu's bottom.

Disks.missing.note: Machines page, Disks: shown in place of a disk's name when the machine attaches a disk whose record is gone.

Disks.meta.note: Machines page, Disks: the small line beside a disk's name. {{kind}} is what it is (Disks.kind.*), {{size}} its size, {{letter}} its device's letter in the guest (vda, vdb…).

Disks.meta.missing.note: Machines page, Disks: the small line beside a missing disk (Disks.missing). {{letter}} is its device's letter in the guest (vda, vdb…).

Disks.readOnly.note: Machines page, Disks: the checkbox on a disk's line: the guest can read it but not write it (off and disabled for a blank disk or a ramdisk).

Disks.swap.title.message: The guest's swap, turned on at every boot with nothing to do inside: the page formats the ramdisk as swap and tells systemd (254+: Debian 13, Arch; not Debian 12). It takes memory as the guest swaps and gives it back as the guest frees it.
Disks.swap.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of a ramdisk's swap checkbox.

Disks.swap.note: Machines page, Disks: the checkbox on a ramdisk's line that makes it the guest's swap.

Disks.inPlace.title.message: The guest's writes go into the stored disk itself: no overlay, no variants, and snapshots can't fork it.
Disks.inPlace.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of a stored disk's write in place checkbox.

Disks.inPlace.note: Machines page, Disks: the checkbox on a writable stored disk's line: the guest writes the disk itself, with no overlay.

Disks.busy.move.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk moves to an earlier or later slot.

Disks.moveUp.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of the up arrow on a disk's line (the disk takes an earlier slot: vda before vdb).

Disks.moveDown.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of the down arrow on a disk's line (the disk takes a later slot).

Disks.detach.button.title.message: Take the disk off this machine (it stays in this browser)
Disks.detach.button.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of the Detach button on a disk's line.

Disks.detach.button.note: Machines page, Disks: the button on a disk's line that takes it off the machine (after a confirmation).

Disks.overlays.label.note: Machines page, Disks: the label before the list of a writable disk's overlays (the variants of its changes), where the user picks the one the machine uses.

Disks.overlays.none.message: (a new overlay, at the next start)
Disks.overlays.none.note: Machines page, Disks: the item of a disk's Changes in list when the machine has no overlay chosen yet: its next start makes one.

Disks.overlays.option.note: Machines page, Disks: an overlay in a disk's Changes in list. {{name}} is its name, {{size}} what it holds.

Disks.overlays.forked.note: Machines page, Disks: an overlay in a disk's Changes in list that a snapshot's restore forked off another. {{name}} is its name, {{size}} what it holds.

Disks.newEmpty.title.message: A new, empty overlay: the disk as the image has it (the one it has now is kept)
Disks.newEmpty.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of New empty.

Disks.newEmpty.note: Machines page, Disks: the button under a writable disk that makes a new, empty overlay (asking its name) and switches the disk to it.

Disks.renameButton.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of Rename, beside the disk's chosen overlay.

Disks.renameButton.note: Machines page, Disks: the button beside a disk's chosen overlay that renames it (a prompt asks the name).

Disks.deleteButton.title.message: Delete this overlay: what was written in it is lost
Disks.deleteButton.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of Delete, beside the disk's chosen overlay.

Disks.deleteButton.note: Machines page, Disks: the button beside a disk's chosen overlay that deletes it (after a confirmation).

Disks.mergeButton.title.message: Write this overlay's changes into the stored disk itself
Disks.mergeButton.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of Merge into the disk.

Disks.mergeButton.note: Machines page, Disks: the button beside a stored disk's chosen overlay that writes its changes into the disk (after a confirmation).

Disks.importChanges.title.message: A changes file (Export › Changes only) of this disk becomes a new overlay, which the disk switches to
Disks.importChanges.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of Import changes….

Disks.importChanges.note: Machines page, Disks: the button under a writable disk (not a blank one) that picks a changes file and loads it into a new overlay.

Disks.none.note: Machines page, Disks: the list's only line when the machine has no disk.

Disks.add.note: Machines page, Disks: the button under the list that opens the Add a disk wizard.

Disks.full.message: {{max}} disks: a machine takes no more.
Disks.full.note: Machines page, Disks: the note in place of Add a disk… when the machine has as many disks as it can. {{max}} is that number.

AddDisk.source.known.message: A disk already in this browser
AddDisk.source.known.note: Add a disk wizard (Machines page): the name of the choice of a disk the browser keeps already (shown only when there is one), on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.known.text.message: A disk another machine has, or one detached: with its overlays, as it was. A disk no machine has can be deleted here, with its overlays, to free the space it takes.
AddDisk.source.known.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what A disk already in this browser means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.known.message: Add a disk: a disk already in this browser
AddDisk.title.known.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once A disk already in this browser is chosen.

AddDisk.source.file.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk image the page reads where it is, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.file.text.message: A disk image (qcow2, raw, or an installer or live ISO) read where it is: nothing is copied. The machine's writes go into an overlay in this browser. In a later session the browser asks again before the page reads the file.
AddDisk.source.file.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what A file on this computer means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.file.message: Add a disk: a file on this computer
AddDisk.title.file.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once A file on this computer is chosen.

AddDisk.source.stored.message: A file, copied into the browser
AddDisk.source.stored.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk image copied into the browser's storage, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.stored.text.message: The image is copied into this browser's storage: no picking again, and it can take an overlay's changes into itself or be written in place. It duplicates the file, in storage you can't easily see outside this page.
AddDisk.source.stored.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what A file, copied into the browser means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.stored.message: Add a disk: a file, copied into the browser
AddDisk.title.stored.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once A file, copied into the browser is chosen.

AddDisk.source.url.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk image on a web server, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.url.text.message: An image on a web server, read in pieces as the guest needs them and kept in this browser (the server must allow this page's origin, and range requests unless it is a chunked image's manifest). Its first reads go over the network.
AddDisk.source.url.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what From a URL means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.url.message: Add a disk: from a url
AddDisk.title.url.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once From a URL is chosen. (Lower-case "url" as the page wrote it before the catalog: the kind's name was lower-cased.)

AddDisk.source.blank.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of an empty disk of a chosen size, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.blank.text.message: An empty disk of the size you choose, for the guest to partition and format. It takes space in this browser only as the guest writes.
AddDisk.source.blank.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what Blank means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.blank.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once Blank is chosen.

AddDisk.source.ramdisk.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk in memory, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.ramdisk.text.message: An empty disk in this computer's memory, empty again at every boot (the guest's reboot too): fast scratch space. It takes memory as the guest fills it, and gives it back when the guest trims (fstrim): all of it on a disk of up to 4 GiB, and the first 4 GiB on a larger one.
AddDisk.source.ramdisk.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what Ramdisk means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.ramdisk.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once Ramdisk is chosen.

AddDisk.busy.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while the Add a disk wizard attaches or makes the disk.

AddDisk.delete.stored.message: the disk ({{size}}, its copy in this browser)
AddDisk.delete.stored.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: what deleting a stored disk deletes, in the confirmation (AddDisk.delete.confirm). {{size}} is the disk's size.

AddDisk.delete.remote.message: what this browser keeps of it (the file or URL itself isn't touched)
AddDisk.delete.remote.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: what deleting a file's or a URL's disk deletes, in the confirmation (AddDisk.delete.confirm).

AddDisk.delete.disk.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: what deleting a blank disk or a ramdisk deletes, in the confirmation (AddDisk.delete.confirm).

AddDisk.delete.confirm_one.message: Delete {{name}}? This deletes {{what}} and its {{count}} overlay: what machines wrote to it is lost.
AddDisk.delete.confirm_one.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks, its overlay empty. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} AddDisk.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} 1.

AddDisk.delete.confirm_other.message: Delete {{name}}? This deletes {{what}} and its {{count}} overlays: what machines wrote to it is lost.
AddDisk.delete.confirm_other.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks, its overlays (none or several) empty. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} AddDisk.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} how many overlays.

AddDisk.delete.confirmSized_one.message: Delete {{name}}? This deletes {{what}} and its {{count}} overlay ({{size}}): what machines wrote to it is lost.
AddDisk.delete.confirmSized_one.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks when its overlay holds something. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} AddDisk.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} 1, {{size}} what the overlay holds.

AddDisk.delete.confirmSized_other.message: Delete {{name}}? This deletes {{what}} and its {{count}} overlays ({{size}}): what machines wrote to it is lost.
AddDisk.delete.confirmSized_other.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks when its overlays hold something. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} AddDisk.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} how many overlays, {{size}} what they hold together.

AddDisk.delete.title.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the title of the confirmation a disk's Delete asks.

AddDisk.delete.ok.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the confirm button of the question before a disk is deleted.

AddDisk.attachedAlready.message: {{name}} is attached to this machine already.
AddDisk.attachedAlready.note: Add a disk wizard: the error under the fields when the file or URL chosen is a disk the browser knows that the machine has already. {{name}} is that disk's name.

AddDisk.urlProblems.message:
The URL can't be a disk:
{{problems, lines}}
AddDisk.urlProblems.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the error under the fields when Add finds the server can't serve the URL as a disk. {{problems}} is what fails (the URL check's problems), one per line.

AddDisk.pickFirst.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on this computer or A file, copied into the browser: the error under the fields when Add is pressed before a file is picked.

AddDisk.store.confirm.message: Store a copy of {{name}} in this browser? It takes about {{size}} of the browser's storage ({{free}} free), which you can't easily see outside this page, and duplicates the file you have.
AddDisk.store.confirm.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into the browser: the confirmation Add asks before copying. {{name}} is the file's name, {{size}} what the copy takes (estimated), {{free}} the browser's storage left.

AddDisk.store.title.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into the browser: the title of the confirmation before the file is copied.

AddDisk.store.ok.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into the browser: the confirm button that starts the copy.

AddDisk.storing.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into the browser: the progress line under the fields while the file is copied. {{name}} is the file's name, {{percent}} how much is done (0–100).

AddDisk.title.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title on its first step (the source not chosen yet). {{machine}} is the machine's name.

AddDisk.where.message: Where does the disk come from?
AddDisk.where.note: Add a disk wizard: the note above the choices of the first step.

AddDisk.known.overlays_one.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: how many overlays a listed disk has, its overlay empty, in its line (AddDisk.known.meta). {{count}} is 1.

AddDisk.known.overlays_other.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: how many overlays a listed disk has, they empty (or none), in its line (AddDisk.known.meta). {{count}} is how many.

AddDisk.known.overlaysSized_one.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: a listed disk's overlay, holding something, in its line (AddDisk.known.meta). {{count}} is 1, {{size}} what it holds.

AddDisk.known.overlaysSized_other.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: a listed disk's overlays, holding something, in its line (AddDisk.known.meta). {{count}} is how many, {{size}} what they hold together.

AddDisk.known.on.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: which machines have a listed disk, in its line (AddDisk.known.meta). {{machines}} is their names, joined with commas.

AddDisk.known.onNone.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: in a listed disk's line (AddDisk.known.meta) when no machine has it (it can be deleted).

AddDisk.known.meta.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the small line under a listed disk's name. {{kind}} is what it is (Disks.kind.*), {{size}} its size, {{overlays}} AddDisk.known.overlays or .overlaysSized, {{users}} AddDisk.known.on or .onNone.

AddDisk.known.attach.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the button on a listed disk that attaches it to the machine (with its overlays).

AddDisk.known.delete.title.message: Delete it and its overlays: frees the space they take in this browser
AddDisk.known.delete.title.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the tooltip of Delete on a disk no machine has.

AddDisk.known.delete.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the button on a disk no machine has that deletes it with its overlays (after a confirmation).

AddDisk.url.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the label of the field for the disk image's URL.

AddDisk.url.checking.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the Check button's words while the page asks the server about the URL.

AddDisk.url.check.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the button beside the URL field that asks the server whether it can serve the URL as a disk.

AddDisk.url.ok.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the line under the field when the check passes and the server said the size; a note on remote disks' first boot follows. {{size}} is the image's size.

AddDisk.url.okUnknown.message: The server can serve it (size unknown).
AddDisk.url.okUnknown.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the line under the field when the check passes but the server didn't say the size; a note on remote disks' first boot follows.

AddDisk.pick.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on this computer or A file, copied into the browser: the button that opens the browser's file picker.

AddDisk.picked.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on this computer or A file, copied into the browser: beside Pick a file…, the file picked. {{name}} is its name, {{size}} its size.

AddDisk.picked.none.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on this computer or A file, copied into the browser: beside Pick a file… before a file is picked.

AddDisk.size.note: Add a disk wizard › Blank or Ramdisk: the label of the disk's size field.

AddDisk.size.unit.note: Add a disk wizard › Blank or Ramdisk: the unit after the size field (mebibytes).

AddDisk.readOnly.title.message: The guest can read it but not write it: no overlay. An installer ISO is read-only.
AddDisk.readOnly.title.note: Add a disk wizard › a file or a URL: the tooltip of the Read-only checkbox (checked by itself for a .iso file).

AddDisk.readOnly.note: Add a disk wizard › a file or a URL: the checkbox that attaches the disk read-only.

AddDisk.back.note: Add a disk wizard: the button that goes back to the first step (the choice of source).

AddDisk.cancel.note: Add a disk wizard: the button that closes the dialog without adding a disk.

AddDisk.add.note: Add a disk wizard: the primary button that adds the disk (not on A disk already in this browser, whose disks have Attach).

disks.pickAgain.note: Error (message bar or Machines page) when a disk that is a file on the user's computer has no handle kept: the page can't read it until the user picks it again. {{name}} is the disk's name.

disks.overlayGone.note: Error on the Machines page (Disks) when an overlay being renamed or merged was deleted meanwhile (another tab).

disks.notThisDisk.message: that overlay isn't one of this disk's
disks.notThisDisk.note: Error on the Machines page (Disks) when the overlay chosen in a disk's Changes in list is gone or belongs to another disk.

disks.overlayRunning.message: a machine is running on it: power it off first
disks.overlayRunning.note: Error on the Machines page (Disks) when an overlay can't be deleted: a machine (in this tab or another) has it open.

disks.onlyStored.message: only a disk stored in the browser takes an overlay in place
disks.onlyStored.note: Error on the Machines page (Disks) when Merge into the disk is asked of a disk that isn't stored in the browser.

disks.overlayNamedRunning.message: a machine is running on {{name}}: power it off first
disks.overlayNamedRunning.note: Error on the Machines page (Disks) when a merge is refused: a machine has the overlay, or another overlay of the disk the merge deletes, open. {{name}} is that overlay's name.

disks.diskRunning.message: a machine is running on the disk: power it off first
disks.diskRunning.note: Error on the Machines page (Disks) when a merge is refused: a machine has the stored disk itself open.

export-worker.noChanges.message: this disk has no changes over an image to save
export-worker.noChanges.note: Error of a disk's Export › Changes only (message bar) when the disk has no overlay: there are no changes to save.

export-worker.writingDisk.note: The page's state line while a disk is exported whole (raw or qcow2), followed by the percentage done.

export-worker.readingBase.note: The page's state line while an export of the changes only reads the disk's image (to record its hash), followed by the percentage done.

export-worker.writingChanges.note: The page's state line while an export of the changes only writes them, followed by the percentage done.

changes.baseUnreadable.message: the base image can't be read at {{offset}}
changes.baseUnreadable.note: Error (message bar) of an export of changes or an import of changes when the disk's image can't be read (e.g. the file changed or went away). {{offset}} is the byte offset of the failed read.

changes.notChanges.message: This file isn't a changes file: it has no base image (it is a disk: use Open disk… to boot it).
changes.notChanges.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the file is a disk image rather than a changes file.

changes.notOurs.message: This qcow2 has a backing file ({{backing}}) but wasn't made by this page's Save disk, so the base can't be checked: its changes can't be loaded.
changes.notOurs.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the qcow2 has a backing file but not the hash this page's exports record. {{backing}} is the backing file's name it records.

changes.otherSize.message: These changes are for a disk of {{size}} bytes (made over {{backing}}); {{label}} has {{baseSize}}. Open the disk they were made over first.
changes.otherSize.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file is for a disk of another size. {{size}} is the size it records (bytes), {{backing}} its backing file's name, {{label}} the disk's name, {{baseSize}} the disk's size (bytes).

changes.checkingBase.note: The page's state line while Import changes… hashes the disk's image to check it is the one the changes were made over, followed by the percentage done.

changes.otherBase.message: These changes were made over {{backing}} (hash {{hash}}…), which isn't {{label}} (hash {{baseHash}}…). Open the disk they were made over first (Open disk…), then load them.
changes.otherBase.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the disk's image isn't the one the changes were made over. {{backing}} is the backing file's name the changes record, {{hash}} the first 12 hex digits of its hash, {{label}} the disk's name, {{baseHash}} the first 12 hex digits of the disk's.

changes.blockWriteFailed.message: block {{block}} can't be written to the browser's storage (is the disk full?)
changes.blockWriteFailed.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when a block can't be written to the new overlay. {{block}} is the 4 KiB block's number.

changes.loadingChanges.note: The page's state line while Import changes… writes the changes into the overlay, followed by the percentage done.

qcow2.version.note: Error when a qcow2 disk image (or changes file) the user opened has a version this page can't read (only 2 and 3). Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened, or of an import. {{version}} is the file's version number.

qcow2.backing.message: qcow2: backing files are not supported: this is a changes file over another image, load it with "Load changes…" over that image, it is not a disk to boot
qcow2.backing.note: Error when the qcow2 the user opened as a disk has a backing file (it is a changes file). Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.encrypted.message: qcow2: encrypted images are not supported
qcow2.encrypted.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image (or changes file) the user opened is encrypted. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened, or of an import.

qcow2.externalData.message: qcow2: external data files are not supported
qcow2.externalData.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened keeps its data in another file. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.extendedL2.message: qcow2: extended L2 entries are not supported
qcow2.extendedL2.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened uses extended L2 entries (subclusters). Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.unknownFeatures.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened has incompatible features this page doesn't know. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened. {{features}} is their bits in hex.

qcow2.zstd.message: qcow2: zstd compression is not supported
qcow2.zstd.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened is compressed with zstd. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.changesClusterBits.message: qcow2: cluster_bits {{bits}} (the changes need clusters of at least 4 KiB)
qcow2.changesClusterBits.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file's clusters are smaller than 4 KiB (or too large). {{bits}} is its cluster_bits field.

qcow2.unsupportedFeatures.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file has incompatible features this page doesn't read. {{features}} is their bits in hex.

qcow2.zstdClusters.message: qcow2: compressed (zstd) clusters are not supported
qcow2.zstdClusters.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file's clusters are compressed with zstd.

qcow2-write.backingNameTooLong.message: the backing file name is too long
qcow2-write.backingNameTooLong.note: Error (message bar) of Export › Changes only when the image's file name is too long to record as the changes file's backing file.

qcow2-write.overlayUnreadable.message: block {{block}} of the overlay can't be read
qcow2-write.overlayUnreadable.note: Error (message bar) of Export › Changes only when a block of the disk's overlay can't be read from the browser's storage. {{block}} is the block's number.

qcow2-write.diskUnreadable.message: the disk can't be read at {{offset}}
qcow2-write.diskUnreadable.note: Error (message bar) of a disk's export (whole, raw or qcow2) when the disk can't be read (e.g. its file changed or went away). {{offset}} is the byte offset of the failed read.

stored.imageUnreadable.message: the image can't be read at {{offset}}
stored.imageUnreadable.note: Error under the fields of Add a disk › A file, copied into the browser when the file can't be read while it is copied. {{offset}} is the byte offset of the failed read.

stored.writeFailed.message: the disk can't be written to the browser's storage (is it full?)
stored.writeFailed.note: Error when a stored disk's blocks can't be written: under the fields of Add a disk › A file, copied into the browser, or on the Machines page when Merge into the disk fails.

stored.stateWriteFailed.message: the disk's state can't be written to the browser's storage
stored.stateWriteFailed.note: Error on the Machines page (or when a machine opens a stored disk) when a stored disk's state file can't be written while an overlay is merged into it.

chunked.notManifest.note: Error when a disk's URL ends in .json but isn't a chunked image's manifest: in Add a disk › From a URL's check, or as a detail when the disks can't be opened. {{format}} is the format the JSON names ("undefined" if none).

chunked.malformed.message: the chunked image's manifest is malformed
chunked.malformed.note: Error when a chunked image's manifest is missing fields or they don't agree: in Add a disk › From a URL's check, or as a detail when the disks can't be opened.

overlay.storageFull.note: Error when a file written into the browser's storage (a kept snapshot, a suspended machine) falls short: the storage is full. Shown as a detail of the error that the snapshot couldn't be saved.
